page.layout: One printed title page, single column, centred; woodcut engraving (a figure on a sea creature) in the middle, no text inside it.

main_text.l: Accesit Rerum ac uerborum præcipuè me-

page.notes: Woodcut engraving of a figure standing on a sea monster, between the index line and the imprint; described, not transcribed. A handwritten mark at top right (a circled number with a stroke) is handwriting and is left out. The initial letters "IN" and "ARISTOTE-" are set in large spaced capitals. "ANDREA HYPERIO" is set in italic capitals; the printed form reads "HYPERIO" with the Y as printed.
